seo.title: JOGI. — Textile & Surface Design Studio
seo.description: JOGI. is a textile and surface design studio creating hand-drawn prints, repeat patterns and custom motifs for fashion, interiors and paper. Est. 2026.

hero.label: Studio Est. 2026
hero.sub: From a single fibre to finished cloth.

paragraphs: Every collection begins away from the screen — with ink, gouache and a block of paper. Motifs are drawn, cut and redrawn until they hold together on their own, then built into repeats that run quietly across cloth, paper and walls.

The studio works with fashion labels, interior brands and independent makers, designing prints that respect the material they will live on: the slub of linen, the weight of cotton, the grain of a wall.
about.portrait_alt: Portrait of the designer behind JOGI. Studio, standing outdoors with arms folded
about.title:
Cloth is a
slow *language.*
about.lede: JOGI. is a small textile and surface design studio, founded in 2026 on a simple belief: a pattern should feel as if a hand has passed over it.
about.quote: “I don’t decorate a surface. I listen for the pattern that is *already* in it.”

works.title:
Collections
*&* prints
works.intro: A selection of prints, dye work, weaving and installations. Select any piece to open its case view.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.text: Loose studies in ink, pencil and gouache. Plants, architecture, old cloth — anything with a rhythm worth keeping.

steps.title: Motif
steps.text: The strongest marks are isolated, refined and redrawn until each motif can stand alone, at any scale.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Motifs are engineered into seamless repeats — half-drop, brick or mirror — so the pattern flows without a visible join.

steps.title: Colourway
steps.text: Palettes are mixed from natural dye references — indigo, madder, walnut — and tested as several colourways per design.

steps.title: Print / Weave
steps.text: Final artwork is prepared for screen, block or digital print, or translated into a weave draft, with production-ready files.

items.title: Textile print design
items.text: Seasonal print collections and one-off designs for fashion and home textiles, delivered print-ready.

items.title: Surface pattern design
items.text: Repeat patterns for wallpaper, stationery, packaging, ceramics and other surfaces.

items.title: Custom motifs
items.text: Bespoke motifs, monograms and placement prints drawn exclusively for your brand or project.

items.title: Collaborations
items.text: Capsule collections, licensing and creative partnerships with brands, artisans and mills.
